title: Record the QQ16 endpoint row-sum maxima
body:
## Summary
- The flag-0 owner reading is stopped. This starts the joint-query card at the pinned endpoint certificate.
- The stored F0 inverse has 224 absolute row sums with maximum 49. The zero-retention decoder has 224 sums with maximum 1923.
- The certificate says it does not implement a physical producer and has no dirty-helper field. No selected frontier change and no new exponent.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/qq16-endpoint-bound/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/qq16-endpoint-bound/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-endpoint-bound`
